_comment: A foot block squares the turn it made onto riders inside its ranks once they are gone, without an order (#1859). A 48-man Infantry block (8 files by 6 ranks) stands on Hold facing east, and a brittle 12-horse Cavalry troop (morale 3) charges it from the north-east, rides into its ranks, breaks and flees south. While the riders are inside the block, each small re-face onto them is folded into the formation (#1792), so the men turn to face them where they stand and the ranks do not wheel round after them: by tick 680, still in contact, the ranks stand 50.9 degrees off the block's heading on the clip seed (45.5 to 52.2 on perturbed seeds 1 to 3, 36.9 on seed 4). Before #1859 that fold stayed for as long as the block got no order. Now the turn made onto the riders is squared on its own once the block is out of contact (ticks 682 to 738 by seed), no faster than the men on the far corners can jog: it is done by tick 820 to 892 by seed, and at tick 900 the ranks read 0.0 to 0.2 degrees off the heading on all five seeds. The tick-900 claim's 1-degree tolerance covers the dump's rounding, which keeps a square grid from reading exactly 0: the heading is written to 2 decimals (up to about 0.4 degrees on its own) and the grid's front to 4. The tick-680 check (50 +/- 15 degrees) only shows the fold is there to square; the tick-8 position, tick-360 Hold, tick-440 FIGHTING and tick-720 ROUTING checks are setup, and tick 900 still reads Hold, so no order squared it. The clip ends at tick 900, before the troop rallies (tick 918 on seeds 0 to 3, 886 on seed 4), since a rallying troop's re-form is not what this clip shows. Static camera. Deterministic (scenario + seed + scripted input). Figures measured with full state dumps every 2 ticks on 3c442b07, where a cavalry troop in contact wheels onto its enemy at a bounded rate (#1806), against main aeb67079.

overlap.reason: Uid 1 (the troop), overlap: the scan fires on some seeds, so the exemption is live. Measured 2026-11-10 on aef5b476, seeds 0 to 4. On dense 2-tick FULL dumps over ticks 2 to 1000, every exemption removed: seeds 0, 2 and 4 pass (worst 14.5, 8.56 and 19.4) and seeds 1 and 3 FAIL (worst 3.21 and 4.28 against the 5.0 threshold). On the clip's own declared ticks it passes on every seed (worst 40), so there the exemption reads STALE. Traced earlier on seed 2 on 3c442b07: the dip is at tick 918, the tick the troop rallies (IDLE), out of contact, with the pair 15.1 and 27.5 wu off their slots as its riders walk back to them, a man walking back from farther off passing through one nearer his slot (#1894). It falls after the clip ends (tick 900) but within the dense scan's window.
